markdown: [Open weights are planned for October 15, 2026.](https://www.stepfun.com/step-5-preview)

Anthropic deprecated `claude-opus-4-1-20250805` on June 5, 2026 and plans to retire it on August 5, 2026. New integrations should move to [`anthropic/claude-opus-5`](/anthropic/claude-opus-5). If you still run Opus 4.1 traffic, use the [Opus 4.1 to 4.8 migration guide](/docs/v1/model-migrations/anthropic-claude-opus-4-1-to-4-8).

Anthropic said on June 12, 2026 that it had to disable Fable 5 and Mythos 5 for all customers to comply with a U.S. export control directive. Requests to this model are currently expected to fail. [Read Anthropic's statement](https://www.anthropic.com/news/fable-mythos-access).

Available only in Muse Code with Meta’s **Power Usage** or **Maximum Usage** subscription, in Standard or Contributor mode. Contributor mode is on by default and allows training on your content; it can be disabled. **No Model API access.** Setting Muse Wonder reasoning effort to max does not select Wonder Full. [Subscription details](https://dev.meta.ai/docs/muse-code/subscriptions).
Classify-1 is a structured decision model. Use the Decisions playground or the `/v1/decisions` endpoint with typed Noul, Choice and Score questions.
Claude Mythos 5.1 requires Project Glasswing approval and is not publicly routable through Phaseo.
Coming soon to Phaseo.

D1.1 is available through the [Liquid API](https://docs.liquid.ai/lfm/models/d1.md). Phaseo routing is planned and currently disabled. OpenRouter and Vercel AI Gateway availability is coming soon, according to Liquid's [23 October announcement](https://x.com/liquidai/status/2113678429040304354).
Deprecated July 15, 2026. Migrate to LTX-2.3 Fast before removal on August 15, 2026.
Deprecated July 15, 2026. Migrate to LTX-2.3 Pro before removal on August 15, 2026.
End of service is scheduled for December 31, 2026 UTC. Migrate to `upstage/solar-embedding-2-passage`.
End of service is scheduled for December 31, 2026 UTC. Migrate to `upstage/solar-embedding-2-query`.

Extract is a task model, not a chat model. Describe the fields to extract with `response_format` `json_schema`; the reply content is a JSON string of matched entities with confidence scores. Streaming and tools are not supported.
Gemini Robotics ER 1.6 is deprecated and will shut down on 31 August 2026. Migrate to Gemini Robotics ER 2 Preview.
GPT Live 1 is available in ChatGPT Voice for Go, Plus, and Pro users. It is also available through [Phaseo's Realtime Room](https://phaseo.app/chat/realtime), which is rolling out now.
GPT Live 1 Mini is available in ChatGPT Voice for Free users. OpenAI says API support is planned soon, but has not confirmed a stable API model ID, pricing, or AI Stats Gateway availability.

GPT Rosalind is available only to organisations approved for OpenAI's [trusted-access program](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001071-models-and-trusted-access). Phaseo routing through the OpenAI provider is disabled.
GPT-6 Astra Pro is a Phaseo model variant that requests OpenAI's documented gpt-6-astra API model with reasoning.mode set to pro. Availability depends on the connected OpenAI account having access.
Lyria 3.5 is currently available in Google Flow Music, but Google has not yet documented a public API model identifier. Phaseo routing will remain disabled until an official endpoint is available.

MiniMax is retiring its hosted M2.5 and M2.7 families, including highspeed variants. From October 19, 2026, they are unavailable to new MiniMax users. Existing pay-as-you-go users retain access until retirement on November 18, 2026; requests stop working after retirement. From October 19, M Plan and Token Plan requests automatically route to M3.1 Flash Preview; existing model names and plan usage allowances remain unchanged. This notice concerns MiniMax-hosted access; other providers have their own availability. Source: [MiniMax retirement notice](https://www.minimax.io/m-plan).

MiniMax's API offers H3 Max through the V2 video-generation endpoint. The provider route is catalogued, but Phaseo routing remains disabled until the MiniMax adapter supports the V2 payload and task lifecycle.
MiniMax's API offers H3 through the `/v2/video_generation` multimodal endpoint. Phaseo routes H3 through the native MiniMax V2 video adapter.
Nex-N2.5-Pro weights are coming soon.
Novita currently reports this model as free; no promotion end date is published.

Novita now charges $0.075 per million input tokens, $0.015 per million cached input tokens, and $0.22 per million output tokens. Verified on 8 October 2026 against [Novita pricing](https://novita.ai/pricing) and its live models API.
Open-weight model; not listed as a selectable model on Fish Audio's hosted API.

Phaseo shows inferred standard short-context pricing for `gpt-5.5-cyber` based on the published [OpenAI Codex rate card](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001106-codex-rate-card). OpenAI's public [API pricing page](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing) does not currently publish a confirmed standard API price row for `gpt-5.5-cyber`, so these values are informational estimates derived from the Codex credit mapping.

Qwen3.8-Max-Preview is a 2.4T-parameter preview available through Alibaba Token Plan, Qoder, and QoderWork. Qwen says testing in China is ongoing; public API model ID, pricing, context limits, and benchmark results have not been published. [Read Qwen's announcement](https://x.com/Alibaba_Qwen/status/2078754377473601787).
Restricted access through Microsoft MDASH; not available through the Phaseo gateway.

Summarize is a task model, not a chat model. Send the text as the last user message; the reply content is a JSON string with a `summary` field. Streaming, tools and sampling parameters are not supported.
Suno V6 is a consumer product release for Pro and Premier subscribers. Suno has not published an official API model ID or API pricing in this announcement, so no Phaseo API route is asserted.
Suno V6 Mini is a consumer product release available to everyone. Suno has not published an official API model ID or API pricing in this announcement, so no Phaseo API route is asserted.
Suno V6 Wild is a consumer product release for Pro and Premier subscribers. Suno has not published an official API model ID or API pricing in this announcement, so no Phaseo API route is asserted.
The direct `solar-pro3-260126` API version is deprecated; use `solar-pro3`.
The FLUX 3 Video API is generally available, while Black Forest Labs still labels the underlying model as a **preview**. Video editing and Omni Reference are not yet available.
The public API currently accepts image URLs and image data URIs only. PDF and file URL inputs are not yet supported.
This legacy model is no longer listed as available through the Runway API.
This model is no longer available through the Runway API. Use Aleph 2.0.
This model is no longer available through the Runway API. Use Gen-4.5 or Gen-4 Turbo.

Union Alpha was retired from provider routing on 2026-09-17. Its identity was later revealed as Unbiased's Pareto 26.9 (unbiased/pareto). This historical record remains in the catalogue; its provider routes, route variants, and pricing are not enabled.
